_comment: ComfyUI API-format workflow: Wan 2.1 FLF2V (first-last-frame to video) SEAMLESS LOOP.
The same still is fed as BOTH the first and the last frame, and the motion prompt demands a locked
camera, so frame N returns to frame 0. Node 16 then drops the duplicated final frame so the
<video loop> seam is invisible.
Keys starting with '_' are documentation only; the VTT strips them before POST /prompt.
Node IDs:
1  UNETLoader                 - Wan 2.1 FLF2V 14B 720p               (models/diffusion_models)
2  CLIPLoader                 - umT5-XXL text encoder, type 'wan'    (models/text_encoders)
3  VAELoader                  - Wan 2.1 VAE                          (models/vae)
4  CLIPVisionLoader           - clip_vision_h                        (models/clip_vision)
5  LoadImage                  - FIRST FRAME <- first_frame (uploaded by the VTT via /upload/image)
6  LoadImage                  - LAST FRAME  <- last_frame  (same file as node 5)
7  CLIPVisionEncode           - vision embedding of the first frame
8  CLIPVisionEncode           - vision embedding of the last frame
10  CLIPTextEncode             - POSITIVE <- motion_prompt (locked-camera prefix enforced by the VTT)
11  CLIPTextEncode             - NEGATIVE: forbids camera motion, zoom, morphing, new objects
12  WanFirstLastFrameToVideo   - size <- width/height (VTT keeps aspect, longest side 1280); 81 frames
13  ModelSamplingSD3           - shift 8 (Wan default)
14  KSampler                   - SEED <- seed
15  VAEDecode
16  ImageFromBatch             - keep frames 0..79 (drop frame 80 == frame 0) for a seamless loop
17  SaveWEBM                   - VP9 WebM @16 fps  <- filename_prefix
Low VRAM? Use the fp8 diffusion model and fewer frames (length 49 -> keep 48 in node 16).

inputs.text: Completely locked static camera, top-down view. Gentle ripples on the water, softly flickering torch flames, faint drifting mist. Seamless loop.

camera movement, pan, zoom, dolly, tilt, rotation, camera shake, perspective change, parallax, morphing, warping, layout change, new objects, people, characters, creatures, text, watermark, flicker of whole frame, brightness pulsing, blurry, low quality
